<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
I have enough context to plan the cross-platform refactoring.

Evaluating how to handle executable binaries across platforms. A JS wrapper script in package.json bin could spawn the native binary, avoiding platform-specific suffixes.

Settled on using `./dist/cli.js` as the package `bin` entry point. Bun and Node handle shebangs automatically, so no platform-specific suffixes are needed. The native binary can remain as an optional PATH install.

Bun automatically appends `.exe` on Windows. The `bin` field should reference the extensionless path for npm compatibility, while documentation should note the platform-specific executable name.

Reconsidering the `bin` change. The project intentionally switched to a native binary to avoid requiring Bun in PATH. Reverting to `./dist/cli.js` would regress that design for `bun link` consumers.

Dynamically rewriting package.json after compilation is too invasive. A JavaScript launcher script would still require Bun or Node to execute. The simplest durable Windows approach is being identified.

Npm creates a `.cmd` shim on Windows for package `bin` entries. This means the `bin` field should point directly to `./dist/stepdown-rule.exe` on Windows. Unix consumers will need a symlink instead. Documentation should cover both installation methods.

The pragmatic fix targets the private local package directly. The build script will select the platform-specific binary path. The package.json bin field will be updated to match the current platform. This avoids fragile workarounds.

The concrete plan is to fix real bugs first. FileService needs correction. The remove-buildinfo script must be portable. AGENTS.md must become a real file. README and CLAUDE need separate Windows and Unix install instructions.

A Windows `.cmd` shim was considered to invoke the native executable, but this still leaves the `bin` field statically configured for one platform.

The final recommendation settles on `./dist/cli.js` as the package `bin` entry point. This preserves `bun link` functionality while the native binary remains available for PATH-based installs. FileService will normalize globs with `path.posix` for cross-platform compatibility. AGENTS.md will be replaced by a regular file copied from CLAUDE.md.

A tiny `sync-agents` script will be added to `package.json` to copy `CLAUDE.md` into `AGENTS.md`. Both files will be kept as regular files rather than symlinks. A brief note will be added to `CLAUDE.md` explaining this duplication for Windows compatibility.
</details></think>
